column1: # /Worksheet Page Column — insert a manual column page break at the
# cell pointer.  Implemented as a column insert with the literal `|::`
# label in row 1: the print engine recognizes it as a column-section
# boundary, dropping the marker column from output and starting the
# next column on a new page.
# A1=L1, B1=L2, C1=R1.  RIGHT commits the entry and advances.
# /WPC inserts a column at C with `|::` in row 1; R1 shifts right to
# D1.  The marker itself is non-printing.
# /WPC left the pointer on the marker column (C1) — anchor at A1
# before entering the print range.  Default pg_length is 0 (no
# chunking inside a section), so the only page boundary is the manual
# Form feed between the two column sections — manual break honored.
